# CANDIDATE: NR4_BREAKOUT_VWAP_PULLBACK

**Filed:** 2026-09-11  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A four-bar narrow range (NR4) signals volatility compression; a breakout that reclaims VWAP offers a high-probability mean-reversion continuation. The edge exists because NR4 identifies contracted volatility, and VWAP reclamation confirms institutional participation, creating a setup with favorable risk-reward when combined with structured exits.

## Mechanism

Entry: When today's high-low range is the narrowest of the prior 4 days (NR4) AND price closes above the NR4 high AND closes above VWAP, enter long at the close of that bar.  
Exit: Chart-stop at the NR4 low (structure invalidation), TP1 at 1.5× risk (risk = entry price - NR4 low), runner trail using a 15% trailing offset from the highest-water-mark.  
Regime filters: VIX <15 and time between 10:00-12:00 ET (avoiding first 30 min opening noise).
